title: Warm Citrusy American Citrus Casserole
description: A cozy American dish featuring almond extract and citrus flavors, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware vessel wrapped in pandan leaves, and is egg-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the orange marmalade, lemon juice, almond extract, and granulated sugar until well combined.
Add the flour to the bowl and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Wrap the ttukbaegi earthenware vessel in pandan leaves, making sure to cover the entire surface.
Pour the melted butter into the wrapped vessel, then add the dough and smooth the top.
Add the water to the vessel and cover with a lid or foil.
Place the vessel in the oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
